## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from Karger publisher pages and domain knowledge of geriatric cognitive disorders editorial culture (clinical neurology / geriatric psychiatry overlap). Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Low — paradigm-unified clinical medicine |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High — cross-cultural dementia research |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Geriatric cognitive disorders — Alzheimer's, vascular dementia, FTD, Lewy body dementia, MCI, cognitive aging clinical research, dementia biomarkers, neuropathology |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **clinical / translational contribution to dementia / geriatric cognitive disorders**.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure cognitive aging without dementia focus redirected to Psychology and Aging.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Pure cognitive aging without dementia focus (consider Psychology and Aging)
- AI use without disclosure per Karger policy
- Inadequate diagnostic specificity

### Soft Tax

Low for dementia / geriatric cognitive research tradition.

### Best Suited For

- Alzheimer's disease research
- Vascular dementia, FTD, Lewy body dementia studies
- MCI research
- Dementia biomarker studies
- Cognitive aging clinical research
- Dementia clinical trials

### Not Recommended For

- Pure cognitive aging without dementia focus (consider Psychology and Aging)
- Pure cognitive neuroscience (consider JoCN)
- Pure clinical psychology without neurodegeneration

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Neuropsychology](../cognitive-science/neuropsychology.md) | APA Division 40 |
| 2 | [Psychology and Aging](./psychology-and-aging.md) | If broader aging focus; APA Division 20 |
| 3 | *(Alzheimer's & Dementia — community contribution welcome)* | Wiley flagship for Alzheimer's |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from a top dementia / neurology venue as "too narrowly clinical-cognitive," DGCD is the Karger home for clinical cognitive aging.
